# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; preparing for the Regent's Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette is an attractive teenager with lovely skin and stylishly arranged brown curly hair. She wears stylish clothes, such as a new dress with elbow sleeves for picnics.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013)_

## Personality

Odette has a lively, dramatic, and social personality. She enjoys gossiping, sharing romantic stories, and participating in school activities like singing and rowing. While she can be easily carried away by excitement or emotion, she also demonstrates a practical side regarding domestic tasks.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

- Excitable  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
- Dramatic  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
- Sociable  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

- Singing and musical execution  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- Pass the Regent's Academy entrance exam in Port Marlow  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## History

Odette lived in Brierley with her family and attended the local schoolhouse under Mr. Pidgeon. In the summer, she welcomed Mrs. Tranter and Nell Harcourt to Pale Sands Cove and helped set up tea. Later that season, she attended the Sunday-school picnic at Gorham Pullen's field, where she nearly fell into the Lake of Glassy Waters while gathering water lilies before her father caught her sash. She enjoyed rowing with the other students and tried ice cream for the first time, calling it divine. She formed a friendly relationship with Nell Harcourt, sharing books, demonstrating new songs, and complimenting Nell's appearance. As an older student in the fourth book, Odette prepared for the Regent's Academy entrance exam, often receiving extra instruction from Mr. Pidgeon.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)_
